features.name: Scenario list navigation
features.notes: UIA tree confirms all 7 scenario titles are displayed in a ListBox (ListItems with correct names). First item is selected (IsSelected: True). However, no content page loads when a scenario is selected - the content area is completely empty (no buttons, text boxes, media players, or any other controls appear in the UIA tree beyond the list itself). Navigation display works but page loading is broken.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A list of 7 scenario titles is visible: Simplest Adaptive Streaming, Event Handlers, Network Request Modification, Adaptive Streaming Tuning, Metadata, Ad Insertion, Live Seekable Range
Clicking a scenario title navigates to that scenario's page content
The currently selected scenario is visually highlighted

features.name: Load button triggers playback
features.notes: No content page loads for Scenario 1. UIA tree search for 'Load' button returns 0 matches. The scenario content frame is empty - no buttons, no description text, no MediaPlayerElement visible.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A 'Load' button is displayed at the top of the scenario page
Clicking 'Load' causes the MediaPlayerElement to begin loading/playing content
A description text block explains the implicit AdaptiveMediaSource creation

features.name: MediaPlayerElement with transport controls
features.notes: No MediaPlayerElement is present anywhere in the UIA tree. The content area where it should appear is completely empty.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A media player area is visible occupying the main content region
Transport controls are visible at the bottom of the player (play/pause, timeline, volume, fullscreen)
Transport controls respond to user interaction

features.name: Load by content ID
features.notes: No ContentSelector controls (ComboBox, 'Load Id:' button) found in UIA tree. Scenario content pages do not load.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A ComboBox displays available content models from the Azure Media Services stub list
A 'Load Id:' button is present next to the ComboBox
Clicking 'Load Id:' loads the selected content into the media player

features.name: Load by custom URI
features.notes: No TextBox or 'Load Uri:' button found in UIA tree. Content pages do not render.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A TextBox with URL input scope is available for entering a custom URI
A 'Load Uri:' button is present next to the TextBox
Clicking 'Load Uri:' loads the entered manifest URL into the media player

features.name: Set Source button and AutoPlay checkbox
features.notes: No 'Set Source' button or 'AutoPlay' checkbox found in UIA tree. Content pages do not render.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A 'Set Source' button is present (disabled until content is loaded)
An 'AutoPlay' checkbox is present, unchecked by default
Checking AutoPlay causes loaded content to begin playing automatically

features.name: Download and playback bitrate indicators
features.notes: Scenario 2 content page does not load. No bitrate indicators visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A download icon (Download symbol) with a bar-level icon and bitrate text is shown
A playback icon (Play symbol) with a bar-level icon and bitrate text is shown
The bar icons update dynamically as the adaptive streaming engine changes bitrates

features.name: Event log view
features.notes: Scenario 2 content page does not load. No LogView panel visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A log panel is visible at the bottom of the scenario page
Streaming events are logged in real time as playback progresses
Events include adaptive source opened, download state changes, and bitrate switches

features.name: Authorization method radio buttons
features.notes: Scenario 3 content page does not load. No radio buttons visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Four radio buttons are displayed: None, Authorization Header, Url Query Parameter, Application Downloaded
Authorization Header is selected by default
Selecting a different method changes how the key request is authenticated

features.name: HDCP protection level controls
features.notes: Scenario 3 content page does not load. No HDCP radio buttons visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Three radio buttons for HDCP: Off, On, On With Type Enforcement
HDCP Off is selected by default
Effective protection text and desired max bitrate text update when selection changes

features.name: Min/Initial/Max bitrate ComboBoxes
features.notes: Scenario 4 content page does not load. No ComboBoxes visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Three ComboBoxes labeled 'Min Bitrate', 'Initial Bitrate', and 'Max Bitrate' are displayed
ComboBoxes are populated with available bitrate values from the content
Changing a selection constrains the adaptive streaming engine to respect the new limit

features.name: Downgrade ratio and headroom ratio controls
features.notes: Scenario 4 content page does not load. No TextBox/Set button pairs visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A TextBox and 'Set' button for 'Downgrade ratio' are displayed
A TextBox and 'Set' button for 'Desired headroom ratio' are displayed
Clicking 'Set' applies the entered numeric value to the adaptive media source

features.name: Inbound bits per second display
features.notes: Scenario 4 content page does not load. No inbound bitrate display visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: An inbound bitrate icon and text display the measured network throughput
The value updates dynamically during playback

features.name: Timed metadata display
features.notes: Scenario 5 content page does not load. No metadata controls or log view visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Content with timed metadata can be loaded via the ContentSelector
Metadata events are logged in the LogView as they are encountered during playback
The description explains HLS/DASH metadata sources

features.name: Ad insertion with progress reporting
features.notes: Scenario 6 content page does not load. No ad insertion controls visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Loading content triggers a playlist with pre-roll ads, main content with mid-roll ads at 10%, and post-roll ads
Playback progress events are logged in the LogView
The MediaPlayerElement plays through the ad sequence and main content

features.name: Live seekable range controls
features.notes: Scenario 7 content page does not load. No seekable window controls visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: MaxSeekableWindowSize and MinLiveOffset are displayed as read-only text
DesiredSeekableWindowSize has a TextBox and Set button to adjust the DVR window
DesiredLiveOffset has a TextBox and Set button to adjust how far behind live edge to play

features.name: Position slider and time display
features.notes: Scenario 7 content page does not load. No position slider or time labels visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: StartPosition, CurrentPosition, and EndPosition text labels display time values
A horizontal slider allows seeking within the seekable range
Position values update as playback progresses

features.name: Discrete seek and playback control buttons
features.notes: Scenario 7 content page does not load. No seek buttons visible in UIA tree.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Seek buttons for fixed amounts (2s, 30s, 5m, 15m forward and back) are displayed
GoToStart and GoToLive buttons are displayed
Play and Pause buttons with symbol icons are present
A 'Log Times' button logs the current time correlation to the LogView
